name: create_kotlin_spring_shipping
description: Adds a Kotlin Spring shipping-cost service and controller
prompts: This Kotlin Spring Boot app (package com.optarena.app; only Application.kt exists) needs a shipping-cost endpoint across two files: (1) create src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/ShippingService.kt - a @Service class with fun cost(weightKg: Double, express: Boolean): Int computing the base cost by weight band (up to and including 1.0 kg costs 5; above 1.0 up to and including 10.0 costs 9; above 10.0 costs 20) and DOUBLING it when express is true; (2) create src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/ShippingController.kt - a @RestController with constructor-injected ShippingService exposing POST /shipping/quote that accepts JSON {"weightKg": number, "express": boolean} (a Kotlin data class body works - jackson-module-kotlin is on the classpath) and returns {"cost": <int>}.
